n3.r1.content:
TRNW's 2027 outlook is for revenue up 6% and operating margin of 14%, up from 12% in 2026. This comes from search snippets only. I didn't open the full documents (trnw-revenue and trnw-margins), so I have no detail on the assumptions behind the figures.

- **Revenue:** The revenue document says revenue is expected to rise 6% in 2027, driven by price increases.
- **Margins:** The margins document says the same price increases lift operating margin to 14% in 2027 from 12%.

Both figures depend on pricing. If the price increases don't stick, revenue growth and the margin gain would both fall short.

n2.r1.content:
Voltaris Grid (VLTG) 2027 outlook: revenue of about C$4.2B and an operating margin near 11%, flat on 2026. I took this from the search snippets for the two VLTG documents (`vltg-revenue` and `vltg-margins`) and did not open the full documents.

- **Revenue:** Management reaffirmed 2027 revenue guidance of C$4.2B. Backlog is C$5.1B, which is about 1.2 times that revenue guidance. The snippet gives no 2026 revenue figure, so I can't state a growth rate.
- **Margins:** Operating margin is expected near 11% in 2027, flat on 2026. The snippet doesn't mention any expansion or pressure.

n5.r1.content:
Ostrand Meters (OSTM) should see 2027 revenue about 20% higher from a new contract, while margins slip by about one point.

- **Revenue:** A smart-meter contract with Norvane Utilities adds about 20% to 2027 revenue (doc ostm-revenue, n5.d2).
- **Margins:** Margins dip one point in 2027 as the Norvane rollout ramps (doc ostm-margins, n5.d3).

The sources give no baseline revenue or margin level, so I can't state absolute figures. They also don't say whether the 20% is the total growth or only the contract's contribution. Both documents are one-line statements.

n6.r1.content:
KLBS's 2027 outlook is for revenue to fall about 5% and for operating margin to hold at about 8%. Both figures come from the two short documents the search returned (n6.d2, n6.d3). I found no other sources, so I can't say how firm they are.

- **Revenue:** The decline reflects share loss to Tarnwell (TRNW) in medium-voltage switchgear.
- **Margins:** A restructuring is what keeps operating margin at 8%. The source gives no 2026 margin, so I can't say whether 8% is up, down or flat.

n4.r1.content:
Braxen Cable (BRXC) looks like a low-growth year in 2027. Revenue should rise about 2%, and margins should come under pressure.

- **Revenue:** I expect about 2% growth. Volumes are flat, so the increase comes entirely from pass-through pricing (higher costs passed on to customers) (n4.d3).
- **Margins:** Copper costs are up 18% and squeeze margins. 2027 earnings are expected to be flat (n4.d2).

The sources give no margin percentage, so I can't put a number on the squeeze. Flat earnings on 2% higher revenue implies margins slip slightly.

n1.r1.content:
**2027 outlook for VLTX's five named holdings**

These come from the five child nodes. Two of them (VLTG and TRNW) worked from search snippets only. I didn't check that these are VLTX's five largest holdings. I used the names I was given.

| Holding | Revenue | Margins |
|---|---|---|
| **Voltaris Grid (VLTG)** | About C$4.2B, flat on 2026 | Operating margin near 11%, flat |
| **Tarnwell Electric (TRNW)** | Up about 6% | Operating margin 14%, up from 12% in 2026 |
| **Braxen Cable (BRXC)** | Up about 2%, a low-growth year | Under pressure |
| **Ostrand Meters (OSTM)** | Up about 20%, driven by a new contract | Down about 1 point |
| **Kelby Switchgear (KLBS)** | Down about 5% | Operating margin holds at about 8% |

- **Strongest outlooks:** OSTM has the biggest revenue growth, although its margin slips. TRNW is the only one with both revenue growth and margin expansion.
- **Weakest outlooks:** KLBS is the only one with falling revenue. BRXC has weak growth and margin pressure.
- **Neutral:** VLTG is flat on both revenue and margin.

The child nodes' results are in n2.r1, n3.r1, n4.r1, n5.r1 and n6.r1.
